matching: A must_find entry is matched by a finding located in the named file whose cited principle is any name in `principles`; `detail` disambiguates. A must_not_flag entry is violated by any finding in its file (id-format.md is a restraint control: the whole file must draw zero findings). An allowed_extras entry excuses a finding at its location from counting against precision.

must_find.detail: the recommendation (typed retry policy) appears only in the final paragraph, hedged ('seems like it could be', 'would likely recommend')
principles: A caveat must be able to change the conclusion

must_find.detail: the Options section precedes the Requirements section, so the recommendation is not checkable against pre-committed criteria
requirements have no must/should tiers and no won't or out-of-scope statements
the retry-everything option (not the recommended one) is elaborated at length in the main line ('deserves a closer look... forty lines... shipped in a day')
principles: A rejected alternative elaborated in the main line

must_find.detail: requirements and analysis are drenched in non-consequential hedges ('should probably', 'it is worth noting', 'might also be the case', 'could potentially', 'arguably', 'perhaps', 'generally speaking')
principles: A caveat must be able to change the conclusion

must_find.detail: the document opens by describing itself ('This document explores... aims to provide a comprehensive overview') instead of stating its conclusion
principles: The document stands on its own

must_find.detail: the options are a bold-label bullet list; each item carries the same attributes and the genre calls for the options table
principles: Options with a recommendation, as a table

must_not_flag.detail: a structurally sound design doc: conclusion first, tiered requirements with won't/out-of-scope, options table with marked recommendation and topping sentence, sketch, appendix with alternatives. Zero findings expected on this file.

allowed_extras.detail: the Analysis section says nothing beyond its hedges ('strengths and weaknesses', 'depending on one's perspective') and can be flagged as filler or a formulaic pattern beyond the hedge-pile finding
